newsitem.title: HONG KONG: S&P assigns Bank Danamon ratings.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns Bank Danamon ratings.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it has assigned Bank Danamon Indonesia long-term and short-term local currency counterparty ratings of BB.
S&P also said it has assigned the bank a Single-B foreign currency counterparty rating.
S&P said the ratings reflect Bank Danamon's sound market position, its adequate asset quality and earnings, improved capitalisation and professional management.
Offsetting these positive features are the bank's aggressive growth strategy, its concentrated ownership structure and perceived high industry risks associated with the Indonesian banking sector.
The rating outlook for Bank Danamon is stable, S&P said.
